usage: agentware review [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--adversarial]
                        [--diff-range DIFF_RANGE] [--diff-file DIFF_FILE]
                        [--acceptance-file ACCEPTANCE_FILE]
                        [--worklog WORKLOG]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --adversarial         run the adversarial audit round (required)
  --diff-range DIFF_RANGE
                        git range to diff (e.g. HEAD~1..HEAD or a base ref)
  --diff-file DIFF_FILE
                        read the unified diff from a file instead of git
  --acceptance-file ACCEPTANCE_FILE
                        path to the feature plan.md whose acceptance criteria
                        the reviewers audit against
  --worklog WORKLOG     feature worklog.md path; when the Q8 escape hatch
                        AGENTWARE_SKIP_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW is set, a self-
                        closing `> DECISION:` skip marker is recorded here
                        instead of running the audit
